findings: Rows are loaded from the exact supplied Lean output bytes; no Python-planned policy is substituted for the returned table.
Parser rejects duplicate object keys, duplicate histories, unknown actions, malformed nonboolean receipts, nonexact rational fields, invalid probabilities and incomplete or extra history rows.
All serialized rows, including zero-mass branches, are checked against the same pre-outcome public request cap and registered off-path clamped wallet.

Every positive native noise path is enumerated with a single initial theta draw, retained conditional normal rate and independent fair labels. Hidden programs, identities and full records are used only by replay.
Actual path prepayment is checked using the requested action before mode/label processing. Actual balances subtract original native_step fees without a clamp.

native_step matches original modeRecordStep, timestamp update and Store.next: missing parents append None, faults damage the selected parent at zero fee, normal writes charge even without birth, genuine children receive allocated slot and copied program/ancestry.

Each reachable supplied action is compared against the independent exact continuation optimum, but the replay still executes the supplied action. Independent optimum equality and declared-value equality are separately checked.

The projected state in the independent reference is valid only for this known-goal public damaged-founder family. The verifier explicitly checks that all native paths with the same receipt history agree on its replay information; the general Lean result instead uses a full joint hidden-world belief.

Planner.solve restricts already-stopped controls to STOP. Other requests after a stop have identical effective root-idle physics, so this does not lower the reference optimum. THIS output checker separately enforces the stricter requested-action cap on such rows.
Native path mass, actual net payoff, probability of at least one birth, undiscounted births, actual fees, unique child slots, clocks and minimum prefix balance are kept as separate outputs.
Resource limits return UNKNOWN and malformed schemas return INVALID_INPUT; neither is mislabeled infeasibility or a mathematical counterexample.
